Calendar year ## Predicted and scheduled events - [January 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_7)– [February 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_5) – The [2027 AFC Asian Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_AFC_Asian_Cup) is scheduled to be held in [Saudi Arabia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saudi_Arabia), across [Riyadh](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riyadh), [Jeddah](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeddah) and [Al Khobar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al_Khobar). It will be the 19th edition of the [AFC Asian Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AFC_Asian_Cup).[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-AFC2027-1) - [January 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_13)– [31](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_31) – The [2027 World Men's Handball Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_World_Men's_Handball_Championship) will be held in [Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Germany), with matches in [Cologne](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cologne), [Hanover](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanover), [Kiel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kiel), [Magdeburg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magdeburg), [Munich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Munich) and [Stuttgart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stuttgart). The final is scheduled for Cologne on January 31.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-IHF2027-2) - [January 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_15)– [25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_25) – The [2027 Winter World University Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Winter_World_University_Games) will be held in [Changchun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Changchun), China. The competition is organized by the [International University Sports Federation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_University_Sports_Federation) (FISU).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-FISU2027-3) - [January 20](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_20)– [February 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_7) – The [2027 African Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_African_Games) are scheduled to be held in [Cairo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cairo), [Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Egypt).[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-AfricanGames2027-4) - [January 30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/January_30) – The [2027 German presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_German_presidential_election) is scheduled to be held by the [Federal Convention](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_Convention_(Germany)) to elect the [President of Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_Germany). - [February 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_14) – [Super Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl) [LXI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LXI) will be held at [SoFi Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SoFi_Stadium) in [Inglewood, California](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inglewood,_California), United States. - [February 21](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/February_21) – The [2027 NBA All-Star Game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_NBA_All-Star_Game) will be played at [Mortgage Matchup Center](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortgage_Matchup_Center) in [Phoenix, Arizona](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phoenix,_Arizona), [United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States). - [March 7](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/March_7) – If not triggered earlier, the [next Estonian parliamentary election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Next_Estonian_parliamentary_election) must be held no later than this date. - [April 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/April_18) - The [2027 Finnish parliamentary election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Finnish_parliamentary_election) is scheduled to be held. - The [2027 French presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_French_presidential_election) is scheduled to be held. - [May 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_11)– [15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_15) – The [71st Eurovision Song Contest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eurovision_Song_Contest_2027) will be held at [Arena Burgas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arena_Burgas) in [Burgas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burgas), Bulgaria. The first semi-final is scheduled for May 11, the second semi-final for May 13, and the grand final for May 15.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-Eurovision2027-5) - [May 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_14)– [30](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_30) – The [2027 IIHF World Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_IIHF_World_Championship) will be held in [Düsseldorf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D%C3%BCsseldorf) and [Mannheim](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mannheim), Germany, with the final round in Düsseldorf. An opening game between Germany and Switzerland is scheduled for May 13 at [Veltins-Arena](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Veltins-Arena) in [Gelsenkirchen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gelsenkirchen).[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-IIHF2027-6) - [May 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_15)– [August 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_15) – [Expo 2027](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Expo_2027) will be held in [Belgrade](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgrade), Serbia, as a [Specialised Expo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Specialised_Expo) under the theme _Play for Humanity: Sport and Music for All_.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-ExpoBelgrade2027-7) - [May 26](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/May_26) – The [2027 UEFA Europa League final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_UEFA_Europa_League_final) is scheduled to be played in [Frankfurt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frankfurt), Germany. - [June 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_5) – The [2027 UEFA Champions League final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_UEFA_Champions_League_final) is scheduled to be played at the [Metropolitano Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metropolitano_Stadium) in [Madrid](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madrid), Spain.[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-UCL2027-8) - [June 6](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_6) – The [2027 Mexican legislative election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Mexican_legislative_election) is scheduled to be held. - [June 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_16)– [27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_27) – The [2027 European Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_European_Games) will be held in [Istanbul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Istanbul), Turkey. The programme is expected to comprise 26 sports and disciplines.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-EuropeanGames2027-9) - [June 19](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_19)– [July 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_17) – The [2027 Africa Cup of Nations](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Africa_Cup_of_Nations) will be jointly hosted by [Kenya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenya), [Tanzania](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tanzania) and [Uganda](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uganda). The opening match is scheduled for June 19 and the final for July 17. It will be the first AFCON tournament jointly hosted by three countries.[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-AFCON2027-10) - [June 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/June_24)– [July 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_25) – The [2027 FIFA Women's World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_FIFA_Women's_World_Cup) will be held in [Brazil](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brazil). It will be the first FIFA Women's World Cup held in South America. The [Maracanã Stadium](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maracan%C3%A3_Stadium) in [Rio de Janeiro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rio_de_Janeiro) is scheduled to host both the opening match and the final.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-FIFAWWC2027-11) - [July 23](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_23)– [August 8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_8) – The [2027 Pan American Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Pan_American_Games) will be held in [Lima](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lima), Peru. More than 6,900 athletes from 41 countries are expected to compete in 38 sports; the opening ceremony is scheduled for July 23.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-Lima2027-12) - [July 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_24)– [August 8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_8) – The [2027 Pacific Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Pacific_Games) are scheduled to be held in [Tahiti](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tahiti), [French Polynesia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Polynesia). - [July 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/July_25) – If not triggered earlier, the [next Greek parliamentary election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Next_Greek_parliamentary_election) must be held no later than this date. - [August 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_1)– [12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_12) – The [2027 Summer World University Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Summer_World_University_Games) will be held in [Chungcheong Province](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chungcheong_Province), South Korea. The Games will be jointly organized across the region's participating cities and provinces.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-FISUSummer2027-13) - [August 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_3)– [8](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_8) – [World Youth Day 2027](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Youth_Day_2027) will be held in [Seoul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Seoul), South Korea. The gathering will bring young people from around the world together with [Pope Leo XIV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Leo_XIV).[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-WYD2027-14) - [August 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_10) – The [2027 Kenyan general election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Kenyan_general_election) is scheduled to take place. - [August 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/August_27)– [September 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_12) – The [2027 FIBA Basketball World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_FIBA_Basketball_World_Cup) will be held in [Doha](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doha), Qatar. The tournament will feature 32 national teams and 92 games across four arenas.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-FIBA2027-15) - [September 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_11) - The [2027 Palestinian legislative election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Palestinian_legislative_election) is scheduled to be held. - The [2027 Palestinian presidential election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Palestinian_presidential_election) is scheduled to be held. - [September 18](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_18)– [September 29](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_29) – The [2027 Southeast Asian Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Southeast_Asian_Games) will be held in [Kuala Lumpur](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kuala_Lumpur), [Sarawak](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarawak), [Penang](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penang), and [Johor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johor), Malaysia. - [September 28](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/September_28) – If not triggered earlier, the [next Slovak parliamentary election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Next_Slovak_parliamentary_election) must be held no later than this date. - [October 1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_1)– [November 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_13) – The [2027 Rugby World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Rugby_World_Cup) will be held in [Australia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australia). The expanded tournament will feature 24 teams, with the opening match in [Perth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Perth) and the final in [Sydney](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sydney).[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-RWC2027-16) - [October 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_2)– [November 21](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_21) – The [2027 Cricket World Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Cricket_World_Cup) will be held in [South Africa](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Africa), [Zimbabwe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zimbabwe) and [Namibia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Namibia). The tournament is scheduled to comprise 14 teams and 54 matches.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-CWC2027-17) - [October 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_16)– [24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_24) – The [2027 Special Olympics World Summer Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Special_Olympics_World_Summer_Games) will be held in [Santiago](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Santiago), Chile. - [October 24](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_24) – The [2027 Argentine general election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Argentine_general_election) is scheduled to be held. - [October 27](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/October_27)– [November 4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_4) – The [2027 Commonwealth Youth Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027_Commonwealth_Youth_Games) will be held in [Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malta).[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2027#cite_note-18) - [November 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/November_11) – If not triggered earlier, the [next Polish parliamentary election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Next_Polish_parliamentary_election) must be held no later than this date. - [December 22](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/December_22) – If not triggered earlier, the [next Italian general election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Next_Italian_general_election) must be held no later than this date. ## References 1. # 2027 public holidays
**Important: These are next year’s public holidays**

This page lists the public holidays for 2027 to help you plan.

## On this page:
- [Queensland](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/public-holidays/2027-public-holidays#qld)
- [Tasmania](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/employment-conditions/public-holidays/2027-public-holidays#tas)

## Australian Capital Territory
- Friday 1 January: New Year's Day
- Tuesday 26 January: Australia Day
- Monday 8 March: Canberra Day
- Friday 26 March: Good Friday
- Saturday 27 March: Easter Saturday – the day after Good Friday
- Sunday 28 March: Easter Sunday
- Monday 29 March: Easter Monday
- Sunday 25 April: Additional public holiday for Anzac Day
- Monday 26 April: Anzac Day
- Monday 31 May: Reconciliation Day
- Monday 14 June: King’s Birthday
- Monday 4 October: Labour Day
- Saturday 25 December: Christmas Day
- Sunday 26 December: Boxing Day
- Monday 27 December: Additional public holiday for Christmas Day
- Tuesday 28 December: Additional public holiday for Boxing Day

## Northern Territory
- Friday 1 January: New Year's Day
- Tuesday 26 January: Australia Day
- Friday 26 March: Good Friday
- Saturday 27 March: Easter Saturday
- Sunday 28 March: Easter Sunday
- Monday 29 March: Easter Monday
- Monday 26 April: Anzac Day
- Monday 3 May: May Day
- Monday 14 June: King’s Birthday
- Monday 2 August: Picnic Day
- Friday 24 December: Christmas Eve (from 7 pm to midnight)
- Saturday 25 December: Christmas Day
- Sunday 26 December: Boxing Day
- Monday 27 December: Additional public holiday for Christmas Day
- Tuesday 28 December: Additional public holiday for Boxing Day
- Friday 31 December: New Year's Eve (from 7 pm to midnight)

## Victoria
- Friday 1 January: New Year's Day
- Tuesday 26 January: Australia Day
- Monday 8 March: Labour Day
- Friday 26 March: Good Friday
- Saturday 27 March: Saturday before Easter Sunday
- Sunday 28 March: Easter Sunday
- Monday 29 March: Easter Monday
- Sunday 25 April: Anzac Day
- Monday 14 June: King's Birthday
- Subject to AFL schedule (date TBC): Friday before the AFL Grand Final
- Tuesday 2 November: Melbourne Cup (some regional areas in Victoria hold the Melbourne Cup public holiday on a different date)
- Saturday 25 December: Christmas Day
- Sunday 26 December: Boxing Day
- Monday 27 December: Additional public holiday for Christmas Day
- Tuesday 28 December: Additional public holiday for Boxing Day
